title: Story vs. Telling Part 4
summary: Kahran walks through how he actually introduces himself in a corporate meeting, beat by beat, and Divya watches the why land between the beats. They take that apart to figure out why Divya's own intro feels flat — the content is there but the conceptual white space, the moments of why I cared, are missing. Kahran's high-school chemistry teacher and Michael Crichton come up as the example of someone weaving science and fiction into one story.
topics: conceptual white space in a pitch
telling your why between the lines
Kahran's path tech to ed-tech to advisory
weaving two interests into one story

intents.display: to learn how to introduce yourself with the why between the beats
